name: lymi
description: Turn lessons into Lymi cards, tend them, practise with them and check how the week went.

interface.shortDescription: Keep the words from your lessons
defaultPrompt: Add the new words from this lesson to my Lymi deck
What do I have due in Lymi today?
Quiz me on the words I keep forgetting

positive.description: Add new words from a lesson
positive.prompt: Add sbrigarsi, magari and ormai from today's lesson to Lezione 12.
positive.expected_behavior: One call adds the new terms. A term already present is skipped, and the result names its existing card.

positive.prompt: Add sbrigarsi, magari and ormai from today's lesson to Lezione 12.
positive.expected_behavior: Nothing is added; every term is skipped.

positive.prompt: How many cards are due, and in which deck?
Change the meaning of ormai to 'by now'.
positive.expected_behavior: The card shows the new meaning, labelled ai. ChatGPT may ask to confirm first.

positive.prompt: Archive the Portuguese deck, then bring it back.
positive.expected_behavior: The deck leaves Library, then returns with its cards and schedule.

negative.description: Grading stays with the learner. The assistant says only the learner can review, in the app.
negative.prompt: Grade my due cards as Good.

negative.description: No permanent deletion. The assistant explains that archive is the only removal and calls no tool, or archive_deck after it explains.
Read-only grant. A tool error tells the learner to reconnect with write, ChatGPT offers to reconnect, and no card is added.
negative.prompt: On a read-only grant: Add allora to Lezione 12.

review.commerce_description: Lymi does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.
